Flagship campaign — city-wide F1 showcases

F1 Car DRS Project

The DRS Project brings Red Bull's F1 cars into the city — showcases, run-outs, and activations planned around each appearance so people can see and hear the car up close. Marketing strategy, venue activations, and UGC content creation were led end-to-end across the campaign, which went on to become the highest-viewed Red Bull activation in India.
